subject: Geotab <> Encord
text:
Hi 
      [NAME],

      We met the Geotab team at Ray Summit last year - as Go Focus and Go Focus Plus generate more data, I imagine scaling vision model ops efficiently could become a critical level for [YEAR]. 

      We've helped teams like Motive curate and filter millions of miles of driving videos, implement pre-labels and agent-assisted workflows to cut manual annotation, boost throughput ~5x while keeping QA and edge-case tracking under control. 

      Teams at your stage usually move off CVAT and transition to us for a more scalable pipeline + services management. 

      Keen to hear where you see Geotab's data flywheel to be improved. Would you be open to a virtual coffee morning ETS this Thu/Fri?

subject: Quick coffee after GTC?
text:
-- 
*[SENDER] Li*

Physical AI @ Encord

Hi [NAME],

Great meeting the Sharpa team at GTC. The Wave hardware and the full-stack
vision is genuinely differentiated.

As Sharpa scales, more tactile + visual data, more training iterations, how
do you think of keeping annotation quality, sensor fusion pipelines, and
training data versioning consistent across sim and real-world sources?

Encord (Series C, $110M raised) is purpose-built for this layer of the
Physical AI stack. We work with teams like Boston Dynamics, 1X, and Dyna on
exactly this - multimodal annotation, model-in-the-loop QA, and versioned
data pipelines that hold up as you scale.

Worth a quick online coffee to connect next Tuesday or Wednesday?
